takeaways: Almost every top 2026 racket pairs a 3D / rough face with a matte look. Only StarVie is known for a gloss frame around a textured face, so Gemini's shiny border plus sandy-matte interior stays distinctive.
Aluminised faces (NOX 18K, Adidas 16K) use sand over the whole face; Gemini II can do the same on its blue half.
Premium looks use ONE accent and quiet branding (Vertex, Hack, Coello). Gemini keeps the laser to strokes only.
3K red with sand/3D (Oxdog, Viper) is a proven performance look, which backs Face I.
